Our Story

Welcome to LE DAKAR

Where the vibrant flavors of Senegal and West Africa come alive in New York. Our kitchen celebrates Senegalese culinary traditions through flavorful rice dishes, grilled meats, fresh fish, rich sauces, and beloved African specialties.

From the iconic Thiebou Djeun to Yassa, Mafé, grilled fish, lamb, and traditional appetizers, every meal brings our guests closer to the flavors and hospitality of Dakar.

About Us

About LE DAKAR

Welcome to LE DAKAR, where the vibrant flavors of Senegal and West Africa come alive in New York.

Our kitchen celebrates Senegalese culinary traditions through flavorful rice dishes, grilled meats, fresh fish, rich sauces, and beloved African specialties.

From the iconic Thiebou Djeun to Yassa, Mafé, grilled fish, lamb, and traditional appetizers, every meal is prepared to bring our guests closer to the flavors and hospitality of Dakar.

Authentic

Traditional Senegalese recipes, prepared with care.

Fresh

Fish, meats, rice and produce prepared fresh for every order.

Welcoming

Warm service inspired by Senegalese teranga.
